cases.title: 16:02 add Aadhaar ₹600 UPI → confirm → 16:03 "Isko remove kardo" → delete preview ₹600 → "Ha" → verified deleted, UPI ₹0, Recycle Bin + audit
A second "Isko remove kardo" after the delete is an honest "already gone" — never a second fake success
Delete flow end-to-end: verified delete → card wording "✓ Delete verify ho gaya"
Save flow verification still works: record present → verified, record gone → not verified
Delete whose target is still in live records is NOT verified (pending fallback wording)
"Hatana hai" (no amount, no isko) → clarification listing recent candidates, never a cloud-style success claim
"Aadhaar 600 wali entry delete kar do" (amount form) still works
Delete with 2 same-amount entries → disambiguation list, then the picked one only is deleted
Delete a non-existent amount → honest "koi entry nahi mili", nothing deleted
A general question right after a verified save must not contradict it
Cloud-guard: fabricated success/contradiction claims are blocked and replaced; benign replies pass through
Regression: "Customer Khata kholo" is navigation, NOT a delete
Regression: "Entry kaise delete karu?" is help, not a delete action
Regression: add flow, checklist offer + "Ha", and service-only delete keep working
